newsitem.title: JAPAN: Pioneer to introduce DVD players in Nov, Dec.
newsitem.headline: Pioneer to introduce DVD players in Nov, Dec.

text.p: Pioneer Electronic Corp said on Thursday that it would introduce four consumer-oriented digital video disc (DVD)-video and DVD-karaoke players on the domestic market in November and December.
The models will include a DVD/LD compatible player, which can play both DVD and laser discs, Pioneer said in a statement.
Pioneer plans to manufacture 10,000 of the players a month, which will be sold for 133,000 yen from November 22.
The standard DVD player will be sold for 83,000 yen, also from November 22, Pioneer said.
